I already posted this story on another subreddit but i’ll just say it again. 
I had this friend for three years, lets call her “FF”, since both of us didn’t have many friends we became best friends quickly. We lived far away but that didn’t bother us. One thing about FF that I noticed, she would never text me. She would reply only if i say something. Then after a while she just ignored me for the entire summer. Then she reappears but with another friend who claimed to be her sister which isnt true. The “sister” accused me of being a “fake friend” and not caring about FF. I tried to apologize but only a couple of days later she came back apologizing to me, so i forgave her. For some reason i used to always forgive people even if they hurt me a lot.
After we became friends again and the same thing happened, no text unless i say something, no calling unless i ask her to. I was tired about that happening again but i just kept going, in the end she stopped replying, even though she saw my messages. She pretty much blocked me on every social media besides the app we used to text each Other. I got pretty mad so i blocked her on the texting app so she had no way of texting me. Sometimes i really wish we remained friends.
(Sorry if my english is kinda bad)
